exposure: Flap type (free transverse rectus abdominis musculocutaneous, deep inferior epigastric perforator, pedicled transverse rectus abdominis musculocutaneous, superficial inferior epigastric artery)
cohort: 519 women younger than 50 years who underwent abdominally based autologous breast reconstruction
finding: Pregnancy following autologous breast reconstruction was not associated with an increased risk of incisional hernia repair.
